hooks.statusMessage: visual-diff-loop: render + diff を実行中...
hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""'); case "$f" in */visual-diff-loop/src/*) proj="${f%/visual-diff-loop/src/*}/visual-diff-loop"; (cd "$proj" && npm run render --silent && npm run diff --silent) >/dev/null 2>&1 || true ;; esac
